items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clark Gable and Carol Lombard used to hang out there too.

ctx.x: . . . the cowboy. He was there virtually every night. They had him Tom Mix the cowboy, but he was from Cincinnati, he was very hip, and he loved jazz. He was there almost nightly. Clark Gable and Carol Lombard used to hang out there too. She was very hip. She was hipper than he was. She was the one that really liked the music. He was the hunting and fishing type, but she kind of civilized him. A lot of people hung out there, a lot of the movie people behind the scenes, a lot of the directors. A lot of the…
You won a Peabody Award and an Emmy Award for that as well.
